commands.name: health
commands.summary: Check Spoonjoy API readiness and whether the caller can use owner-scoped write operations.

commands.name: auth-status
commands.summary: Report the current Spoonjoy MCP authentication state and how an agent should obtain delegated access without asking for raw user credentials.

commands.name: start-agent-connection
commands.summary: Start a browser-approved delegated Spoonjoy connection for this agent. Show the user authorizationUrl and, separately, userCode: they open the link, sign in and type the code to approve. Then poll with deviceCode. Grants kitchen and shopping-list scopes only, never account access.

agent-name.description: The agent's name, shown to the person when they approve.

base-url.description: The Spoonjoy server's URL, when it isn't the default.

scopes.description: The scopes to ask for, separated by spaces or commas.

commands.name: poll-agent-connection
commands.summary: Poll a pending delegated Spoonjoy connection. When approved, the Spoonjoy MCP bridge activates and caches access; never ask for a Spoonjoy password.

token-name.description: The name to give the token once approved.

base-url.description: The Spoonjoy server's URL, when it isn't the default.

commands.name: create-api-token
commands.summary: Create an owner-scoped Spoonjoy API token. The token is returned once and is stored hashed.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

scopes.description: The token's scopes, as one string separated by spaces or commas, or as a list, as JSON.

expires-in-days.description: Days until the token expires, 1 to 365. Defaults to 90. Pass null or "never" for a token that never expires, as JSON.

commands.name: list-api-tokens
commands.summary: List API token metadata for the configured owner. Token secrets are never returned.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

commands.name: revoke-api-token
commands.summary: Revoke one API token owned by the configured owner.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

commands.name: search-spoonjoy
commands.summary: Full-text search Spoonjoy recipes, cookbooks, chefs, and the configured owner's private shopping list. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

scope.description: What to search: all, or one kind of result.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

commands.name: search-recipes
commands.summary: Full-text search Spoonjoy recipes by title, description, source URL, steps and ingredients, optionally limited to one chef by username, or to your own recipes by your own chefEmail. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

chef-username.description: Only recipes by the chef with this username.

chef-email.description: Only your own recipes: must be your own email. Any other address returns no recipes.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

commands.name: get-recipe
commands.summary: Fetch a Spoonjoy recipe by id or exact title with ordered steps and ingredients.

id.description: The recipe's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The recipe's exact title, when you don't have its id.

commands.name: create-recipe
commands.summary: Create a Spoonjoy recipe for the configured owner, including steps and ingredients.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

description.description: A short description of the recipe.

servings.description: How many it serves, such as 4 or 4-6.

source-url.description: Where the recipe came from, as a URL.

image-url.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_recipe_image.

steps.description: The recipe's steps, in order, each with its ingredients, as JSON.

commands.name: update-recipe
commands.summary: Update a recipe owned by the configured owner. With steps, the recipe's steps become the given list, in order: a step with an id updates that step, a step without one updates the step at its position or is added, and steps left out are removed. Updated steps keep their ids, their ingredients keep theirs, and a step keeps the steps whose output it uses unless outputStepNums says otherwise. Each ingredient appears in one step only.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

description.description: A short description of the recipe, or null to clear it.

servings.description: How many it serves, or null to clear it.

source-url.description: Where the recipe came from, as a URL, or null to clear it.

image-url.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_recipe_image, or null to clear it.

steps.description: The recipe's steps, in order; steps left out are removed, as JSON.

commands.name: delete-recipe
commands.summary: Soft-delete a recipe owned by the configured owner.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

commands.name: upload-recipe-image
commands.summary: Upload a recipe photo from base64 bytes and return a Spoonjoy image URL for recipe cover assignment.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

filename.description: The photo's file name, such as lasagna.jpg.

commands.name: fork-recipe
commands.summary: Fork an existing Spoonjoy recipe into the authenticated principal's kitchen. Clones title, description, servings, steps, ingredients, and step-output uses; snapshots the source's latest cover; sets sourceRecipeId on the new recipe. Retrying the same fork (the same idempotencyKey, or the same source and title without a key) within 24 hours returns the first fork instead of creating another, unless that fork was deleted.

source-recipe-id.description: The recipe to fork, by id.

title.description: Optional title override. Subject to the same `(chefId, title)` collision suffixing as the default title.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key for a replay-safe fork; reuse it when retrying.

commands.name: list add
commands.summary: Add or restore one item on the person's shopping list. It adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

args.name: name
args.description: What to buy, such as eggs or flour.

quantity.description: How many or how much, as a number above 0. Leave it out when it doesn't matter.

unit.description: The unit for the quantity, such as grams, cups or cans. Leave it out for a plain count.

category-key.description: Optional. The aisle's category key, such as produce or pantry.

icon-key.description: Optional. The item's icon key, such as wheat or package.

idempotency-key.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the item is added once.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose list, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts on their own list.

commands.name: get-shopping-list
commands.summary: Fetch the configured owner shopping list.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

commands.name: search-shopping-list
commands.summary: Full-text search the configured owner's private shopping list by ingredient, unit, category, icon, and checked state. Without commas every query word must match; commas separate alternatives, so a result matching any of them is returned, ordered by how many alternatives it matches, and at most 12 alternatives are used.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.description: The words to search for. Every word must match; commas separate alternatives, any of which may match.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

commands.name: set-shopping-list-item-checked
commands.summary: Set checked state for one active item on the configured owner shopping list.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

checked.description: True to check the item off, false to uncheck it.

commands.name: remove-shopping-list-item
commands.summary: Soft-remove one item from the configured owner shopping list.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

commands.name: add-recipe-to-shopping-list
commands.summary: Add all ingredients from a recipe to the configured owner shopping list. Each ingredient adds to the quantity of a matching item still on the list (same ingredient and unit); a removed or cleared matching item comes back at the added quantity, not on top of its old one.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

recipe-id.description: The recipe whose ingredients to add, by id.

idempotency-key.description: Optional. Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, such as after a timeout, and the items are added once.

commands.name: list-cookbooks
commands.summary: List cookbooks owned by the configured owner, with active recipe counts and covers.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

query.description: Only cookbooks whose title has these words.

limit.description: The most results to return, 1 to 25.

commands.name: get-cookbook
commands.summary: Fetch one cookbook owned by the configured owner by cookbookId or exact title.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbook-id.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbook-title.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

commands.name: create-cookbook
commands.summary: Create or return an existing cookbook for the configured owner by exact title.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

title.description: The cookbook's title; an existing cookbook with this exact title is returned instead.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the cookbook the first call made, with created: true and mutation.replayed: true.

commands.name: add-recipe-to-cookbook
commands.summary: Idempotently add an active recipe to a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbook-id.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbook-title.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

commands.name: remove-recipe-from-cookbook
commands.summary: Idempotently remove a recipe from a cookbook owned by the configured owner.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

cookbook-id.description: The cookbook's id. Give this or its title.

title.description: The cookbook's exact title, when you don't have its id.

cookbook-title.description: The same as title; title wins when both are given.

commands.name: create-spoon
commands.summary: Create a RecipeSpoon (cook event) authored by the authenticated principal.

recipe-id.description: The recipe that was cooked, by id.

photo-url.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo.

next-time.description: What to do differently next time.

cooked-at.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key (8-100 letters, digits, '_' or '-') for replay-safe creation: a repeat with the same key returns the spoon the first call made instead of logging a second cook.

commands.name: update-spoon
commands.summary: Update note, nextTime, photoUrl, or cookedAt on a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

next-time.description: What to do differently next time.

photo-url.description: A Spoonjoy image URL from upload_spoon_photo, or null to remove the photo.

cooked-at.description: When it was cooked, as an ISO date-time; now when left out.

commands.name: delete-spoon
commands.summary: Soft-delete a spoon owned by the authenticated principal.

commands.name: list-spoons-for-recipe
commands.summary: List the most-recent non-deleted spoons for a recipe.

commands.name: list-spoons-by-chef
commands.summary: List the chef's most-recent non-deleted spoons across all recipes.

commands.name: upload-spoon-photo
commands.summary: Upload a spoon/cook photo from base64 bytes and return a Spoonjoy image URL for spoon assignment.

owner-email.description: Optional. Whose kitchen, for a local server with no signed-in person; a signed-in caller always acts as themselves.

filename.description: The photo's file name, such as dinner.jpg.

commands.name: list-recipe-covers
commands.summary: List Recipe Photo Studio cover candidates. Owners with kitchen write access receive full cover history; other readers receive active public cover metadata only. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed.

recipe-id.description: Recipe whose cover candidates should be listed.

include-archived.description: Include archived cover candidates in the owner-only history.

limit.description: Maximum number of cover candidates to return.

commands.name: list-recipe-spoon-images
commands.summary: List owner-only Spoon photos that can be used as Recipe Photo Studio cover sources.

recipe-id.description: Recipe whose Spoon photos should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of Spoon photos to return.

commands.name: create-recipe-cover-from-upload
commands.summary: Create a Recipe Photo Studio cover candidate from an uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that will receive the cover candidate.

image-url.description: Spoonjoy uploaded recipe or spoon photo URL to use as the original cover source.

activate-when-ready.description: Make the cover active when the editorial image is ready.

generate-editorial.description: Generate an editorialized cover from the uploaded original photo.

prompt-addition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide editorial cover generation.

post-as-spoon.description: Also create a Spoon entry to preserve the original photo with optional cook notes.

note.description: Spoon note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

next-time.description: Spoon next-time note used when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

cooked-at.description: ISO date-time for the Spoon cook when postAsSpoon preserves the original photo.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key for replay-safe cover creation.

plan-only.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

commands.name: generate-recipe-cover-placeholder
commands.summary: Generate an AI placeholder cover candidate for a recipe with an optional prompt addition.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that will receive the generated AI placeholder cover.

prompt-addition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide AI placeholder generation.

activate-when-ready.description: Make the generated cover active when the generated cover is ready.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key for replay-safe placeholder generation.

plan-only.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

commands.name: regenerate-recipe-cover
commands.summary: Regenerate the editorial image for a recipe cover candidate with an optional prompt addition.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

prompt-addition.description: Optional bounded instruction to guide regenerated editorial output.

activate-when-ready.description: Make the regenerated cover active when the regenerated cover is ready.

plan-only.description: Validate inputs and return planned next actions without writing a cover.

commands.name: get-cover-generation-status
commands.summary: Fetch Recipe Photo Studio generation status and active-cover context. May record that an abandoned generation failed: a cover still processing ten minutes after its generation started is reported, and stored, as failed, so polling can stop.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

cover-id.description: Recipe cover candidate whose generation status should be fetched.

commands.name: set-active-recipe-cover
commands.summary: Set one existing Recipe Photo Studio cover variant as the active recipe cover.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

variant.description: Cover variant to activate: image or stylized.

commands.name: set-recipe-no-cover
commands.summary: Set an explicit no-cover state for a recipe after destructive no-cover confirmation.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that should intentionally display no cover.

confirm-no-cover.description: Required explicit confirmation before entering no-cover mode.

idempotency-key.description: Stable key for replay-safe no-cover changes.

commands.name: archive-recipe-cover
commands.summary: Archive a Recipe Photo Studio cover. Archiving the active cover requires a replacement or explicit no-cover confirmation.

recipe-id.description: Recipe that owns the cover candidate.

replacement-cover-id.description: Replacement cover candidate to activate when archiving the active cover.

replacement-variant.description: Replacement variant to activate: image or stylized.

confirm-no-cover.description: Use explicit no-cover mode when archiving the active cover without a replacement.

delete-safe-objects.description: Request deletion of safe owned image objects after archive when supported.

connection approve.reason: You can't approve access to the person's Spoonjoy account; only they can.
connection approve.how: with Approve access on the connection page, after typing the code you showed them
